magnetic_sector.statement: in the declared quotient branch every pure magnetic flux class is allowed and every electric line class outside the descended lattice is forbidden

dyonic_line_lattice.theta_dependence: the remaining eight maximal isotropic subgroups are the theta-tilted variants of the quotient lattices; the tilt under a vacuum angle is a named open direction owned by the strong-CP issue, and this certificate fixes the untilted normalization

unquotiented.distinguishing_observation: every electric line class occurs and only the trivial flux class exists

z2_quotient.distinguishing_observation: electric line classes of even center charge with two flux classes

z3_quotient.distinguishing_observation: electric line classes of center charge zero or three with three flux classes

z6_quotient.distinguishing_observation: only descended electric line classes with all six flux classes; the declared branch

kill_rule_summary: a physical state violating the descent congruence
a free fractionally charged color singlet
a color triplet outside the descending charge classes
an electric line class outside the descended lattice
a dyonic line class outside the maximal isotropic lattice
a flux and line refinement with index other than six
physical_attachment: OPEN: the line-operator and flux observables have no laboratory attachment map on the declared source interface; every kill rule is conditional on the named z6 global-form branch

registered_kill_rules.kill_rule: a physical flux and line refinement with a different finite index falsifies the selected global form branch
one confirmed physical state violating the congruence falsifies the selected global form branch
one confirmed color-triplet state outside the descending classes falsifies the selected global form branch
one confirmed free color-singlet particle with fractional electric charge falsifies the selected global form branch
one confirmed electric line class outside the descended lattice falsifies the selected global form branch

reopen_condition: a physical line-operator or flux attachment map, at which point the registered kill rules become scorable through the issue #639 protocol
